summary: Pushes a player within 20' back 50' in a straight line away from the caster, even if Stopped or Stunned; self-cast picks the direction.

effects.subject: target
effects.note: Moved back 50' in a straight line away from the caster; a Forced Movement effect.

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: If the caster is the target, they move 50' in a direction of their choice.

termination.note: Ends if the target becomes Frozen, Insubstantial, Invulnerable or Stunned (a target who is already Stunned when it is cast is still moved, per E2).

properties.note: Works on Stopped and Stunned players, an exception to the Forced Movement rule that such effects fail on Stopped players.
Only when the caster targets themselves: they choose the direction.

references.name: stunned
references.note: Throw works on Stunned players, but ends if the target becomes Stunned.

clarifications.text: Throw works on players who are Stopped or Stunned when it is cast.

open_questions: E2 says Throw works on Stunned players while N2 ends it when the target becomes Stunned; read as: already Stunned when cast is moved, becoming Stunned during the movement ends it.
